issue_context.title: Reference the V1Secret type in api/core/types.go
issue_context.body:
the V1Secret page: V1Secret https://github.com/kubernetes-client/python/blob/master/kubernetes/docs/V1Secret.md
says:

`type | str | Used to facilitate programmatic handling of secret data.` It's not enough to understand what type is or what are the values expected there.
It should reference to https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/secret/#secret-types
which explains the different types (Opaque, kubernetes.io/service-account-token, etc..)

Referencing original issue https://github.com/kubernetes-client/python/issues/1487
comments:
keeping this open in k/k since there is a PR here as well:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/105901
(not only a python client issue it seems?)

/sig auth api-machinery
@neolit123 -- this should be an issue with all generated clients as they use the OpenAPI spec to generate the necessary code and documentation.

This is an API documentation change. 

/assign @shivanshu1333
